hold_reasoning: HOLD. The book is full: six real positions (4GLD.DE 307.90, BTC-EUR 408.93, ALV.DE 274.95, AIR.PA 275.52, NVDA 273.03, PHAG.L 243.48 EUR) plus a 0.15 EUR SLB remnant, against EUR 221.29 cash on a book of about EUR 2,005. The only new thesis at conviction 7 is sharp-shooter-eur on OMV.VI and EVK.DE. Taking it would need a minimum EUR 250 slot, and cash allows at most about EUR 71 above the EUR 150 floor. So it could only be funded by exiting a holding, and no held thesis has broken. On BTC-EUR, satoshi (6) calls the move a shakeout above the EUR 70.7k shelf and yolo-sapiens-eur (6) stands aside, not exit. The verified 74,351.66 is above both break levels (72.5k, 67.5k). On PHAG.L, goldfinger is still bidding silver into weakness. Verified 53.57 USD matches the note's 'below 54' with no discrepancy. NVDA is weak (230.48 against yolo-sapiens-usd's 229.85 short-confirm), but that note is conviction 3 with no exit bias, which does not count as a break. 4GLD.DE (118.16), ALV.DE and AIR.PA have no exit signal; AIR.PA is down about 9% from cost but no analyst has flipped. BTC-EUR at 408.93 is about EUR 9 over the EUR 400 cap. The SLB remnant (0.15 EUR) is left alone: selling it would cost the EUR 1.25 IBIE floor, which is more than the sale raises. No trigger is worth parking: any OMV/EVK entry would still have no cash to fill against. Default HOLD.
